rationale: Both Fujia and Remi work in energy infrastructure with complementary technical depth—Fujia brings hardware specialization in solar and storage systems for data centers and telecoms, while Remi leads technical architecture at AICE Power with expertise in embedded systems and power systems engineering. Their overlapping domains in energy and infrastructure, combined with Remi's embedded and software background (Python, C) and Fujia's hardware focus, create natural synergy for exploring technical collaboration or knowledge exchange.
intro_message: Fujia Zhang, meet Remi Bouteiller — you're both deep in energy infrastructure (solar/storage and power systems respectively) and could compare approaches to hardware-software integration in this space.
